### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/spec`, touching **6** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **17** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/liveness/action.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/app.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/dashboard.json`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**13** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/concepts/metadata-driven.mdx`  _(via FieldSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_
- `content/docs/data-modeling/analytics.mdx`  _(via DatasetMeasureSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_
- `content/docs/data-modeling/external-datasources.mdx`  _(via FieldSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_
- `content/docs/data-modeling/field-types.mdx`  _(via FieldSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_
- `content/docs/data-modeling/validation-rules.mdx`  _(via FieldSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_

- `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx`  _(via FieldSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_

⛔ **4** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v15.mdx`  _(via PageComponentSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-0.mdx`  _(via FieldSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-1.mdx`  _(via FieldSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-7.mdx`  _(via PageComponentSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **17** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/liveness/action.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/app.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/dashboard.json`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **142** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 744b73f53f716ea45cc1078c403db0d42761cbab` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `63448079ef93f64d7797b396fa7179429e232e3b` — the merge of head `be8657fa446caddb5ec4de9777016c103621fe10` into base `744b73f53f716ea45cc1078c403db0d42761cbab`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 63448079ef93f64d7797b396fa7179429e232e3b && git checkout 63448079ef93f64d7797b396fa7179429e232e3b
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 744b73f53f716ea45cc1078c403db0d42761cbab be8657fa446caddb5ec4de9777016c103621fe10 && git checkout -B drift-repro 744b73f53f716ea45cc1078c403db0d42761cbab && git merge --no-ff be8657fa446caddb5ec4de9777016c103621fe10

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 744b73f53f716ea45cc1078c403db0d42761cbab
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 744b73f53f716ea45cc1078c403db0d42761cbab` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## 席位核对

`domain:spec` seat 4 (#18917) · `sunhaolin` · session `session_0121ooBYRmS8ziFXm9ai5YHm` · claim `6181304005` on #23434 · reviewed head `be8657fa446caddb5ec4de9777016c103621fe10` · 2026-10-15T03:31Z

**Verdict: ACCEPT.** Not governed (`check-governed-merges --pr 23591`). 49 files, +336 / −1,418, under the 3,000-line line. Prose and ledger-note work with `Clause-②: no`, so no contract review is owed; this record is the review.

1. **Shape.**

   - No closing keyword aimed at #23434 remains in the body. The dev's check found none in the branch's commit messages either.
   - `Clause-②: no` sits at line start. `.changeset/23434-component-read-points-part-3.md` is a `@objectstack/spec` patch.
2. **Scope against the claim.**
   - Items 1 (group C outside `component.zod.ts`), 2 (the two held-back moves) and 3 (the other spellings) are done; split as the claim set it.
   - The card stays open for one remainder, by this seat's reading of ruling `6165388570`'s item 1 ("The published spec source carries no renderer citation after this"): 17 sha-less `File.tsx:NNN` lines in 8 published files, listed in this PR's acceptance notes.
3. **Merge round.**
   - `main`'s #23568 removed the `interfaceConfig.emptyState` omit row whose `why` text this branch edited. Merge `7ea3bb007d` takes `main`'s side, and this PR no longer touches `metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts`.
   - The `page.json` `interfaceConfig` note now records that reading in the past tense.
   - `git merge-tree` against `origin/main` `2372e0a7b7` (parts 1 and 2 already merged) is clean.
   - The dev's report gave the head as `be8657fa446c9a0b…`. Only the first 12 characters are right; git reads `be8657fa446caddb…`, and that is the head reviewed here.
4. **Seat readings, taken on this head.**
   - **Code.** I compared parser-accurate token streams (AST leaves, JSDoc excluded) of all 39 changed `.ts` files against merge base `744b73f53f`. Every published file is identical. The only differences are string literals in two test files: a test name in `component-element-navigation-17987.test.ts`, and two message strings in `component-props-unknown-members.pin.test.ts`.
   - **Ledger.** I deep-compared the 8 changed `liveness/*.json` files against the base. Every changed path is a `note`; no verdict, evidence or producer moved. The `regions` note is byte-identical to the one parts 1 and 2 landed.
   - **Evidence.** All 29 `objectui @SHA FILE#SYMBOL` references in the notes this part edits outside `regions` resolve at their own SHAs, across 8 trees. In every one, the file exists and the symbol occurs.
   - **CI.** On this head: 48 check-runs, 41 success, 7 skipped, 0 other. The skip roster answers OK.
   - **Changeset.** Its headline says live read points no longer tie to an objectui commit or the console pin. Its "Unchanged on purpose" bullet names the exception: citations with no ledger row stay, and the PR lists them. Read together, the note is accurate.
5. **Accepted deviations.**
   - The PR body was written by the seat rather than the dev.
   - `check:platform-checklist` is red on the base with the same 7 ABSENT SYMBOL anchors; #23593 (watchdog) carries it.
6. **Out-of-scope dispositions.**
   - The 17 published `File.tsx:NNN` lines stay with #23434, as above.
   - The 30 test-fixture provenance citations are writer provenance, not renderer read points. They stay.
   - The `interfaceConfig.emptyState` finding is resolved on `main` by #23568.
7. **Landing clauses.**
   - (a) Every check is green or skipped by design: met at this record.
   - (b) `mergeable_state` is clean at enqueue: read at landing.

### ① Derived judgments

Post-hoc review of PR #23591 (part 3 of 3 of PR-2 for card #23434), judged as if it were still waiting to enter the queue. Inputs: the card body and every comment (rulings `6165388570` and `6181034096`; dev reports `6168538808`, `6170782619`, `6183204136`, `6183710619`), the PR body and file list, the net diff `744b73f53f..be8657fa44` (49 files, +336 / -1,418; the head carries the merge `7ea3bb007d` of `main`, and `744b73f53f` is the merge base, so nothing of `main`'s is in that diff), and the 50 check-runs on the head. Every reading below is a `git show` / `git diff` of fetched refs in this repo, or a `git show` / `git grep` of the sibling objectui clone at the cited SHA; nothing was built, run or re-run.

**Accept set: unchanged (right).** Of the 38 changed `.ts` files, 36 are byte-identical to `744b73f53f` once comments are stripped (string literals kept). The two that differ are test files, and they differ by exactly five string literals: `src/ui/component-element-navigation-17987.test.ts` (one `it(…)` name) and `src/ui/component-props-unknown-members.pin.test.ts` (one `why` reason string, the definition list's `toText` line; the two concatenated pieces of one assertion message; one `it(…)` name). Test files are not in `files[]` and are not compiled into `dist`, so none of that ships; none is a schema, a `.describe()`, an export or a default. No Zod shape, strict door, refinement, export or type changed anywhere in the diff. `Test Core` (6 of 6 shards) is green on the head.

**Published surface that does change, all of it prose or ledger, all right:**

1. Docblocks in published `.zod.ts` sources (`files[]` lists `src/**/*.zod.ts`; the `.d.ts` docblocks follow): `data/field.zod.ts` (head 456-460 the `currencyConfig.precision` retirement; 1713-1715 the lookup snake-case twins), `ui/app.zod.ts` (433-434), `ui/bulk-action.zod.ts` (158-159), `ui/dashboard.zod.ts` (269-271, 694-695), `ui/dataset.zod.ts` (280-289, a 118-line hop chain replaced by a six-line reading), `ui/expression-bindable-text-keys.zod.ts` (49-57 the read-point table loses its three file names, 66), `ui/page.zod.ts` (320-322, 425, 433, 646-650, 657, 673, 926-930), `ui/view.zod.ts` (1310-1311, 1897-1904, 2632-2635, 4244-4245). No `status`, `evidence`, `producer` or `verifiedAt` changes; `check:liveness` reads `evidence` and `producer`, not `note`; `Spec property liveness` is green.

The table there loses the three renderer file names and keeps the key sets; the reader is sent to `page.regions` entry [118], which records them by symbol (`statistic.tsx#StatisticRenderer`, `card.tsx#CardRenderer`, `button.tsx#ButtonRenderer`, and the deliberate `text` omission).

The last of these still carries line numbers (`:1596-:1611`); that is a pre-existing note outside this diff, and ruling item 2's symbol spelling would be a one-line follow-up there, not a finding against this PR.
- The empty-state `link`'s four read points (`view.zod.ts` 1897-1904 used to cite `ListView.tsx:5716`, `ListEmptyState.tsx:153`, `ObjectGrid.tsx:6897-6899`, `InterfaceListPage.tsx:509`) are all still findable: the `ListView` hand-off and the `ObjectGrid` draw site stay in `view.json` `list.emptyState`'s existing sentence and in `page.regions` entry [34] (`B#renderedGridContent (EmptyStateLink)`), the `ListEmptyState` site is the new symbol clause, the `InterfaceListPage` site is in `page.json` `interfaceConfig`. ### ② Semver level

`.changeset/23434-component-read-points-part-3.md` declares `'@objectstack/spec': patch` and carries `Clause-②: no`; the PR body's third line is `Clause-②: no`. Both are right. The packed tarball changes (published `.zod.ts` sources, `dist` docblocks and `liveness` notes), so a changeset is owed and `skip-changeset` would be wrong; no accept set widens or narrows (the five test-string edits publish nothing; no `.describe()` text changed), so `no` with no arm is the correct declaration and `patch` is its level (`yes` would demand at least `minor`; nothing narrows). The changeset body names what moved and what stays, as ruling `6165388570` item 5 asks. The regenerated `content/docs/references/**` page is the AUTO-GEN artifact of the docblock and is committed with it, as the spec-artifact rule requires; it is not a release-owned page. `Check Changeset` is green on the head (both runs).
